description: This file defines the AppUpdateWorker class responsible for managing app update tasks, scheduling periodic updates, and handling manual update triggers within an Android application using WorkManager.

classes.name: AppUpdateWorker
classes.description: A worker class that handles app update operations, scheduling, and foreground notification management.

methods.name: updateAppsNow
methods.description: Triggers an immediate app update check, respecting network and user settings.

methods.name: scheduleOrCancel
methods.description: Schedules or cancels periodic app update work based on user preferences.

methods.name: doWork
methods.description: Performs the app update operation, updating apps and handling retries.

methods.name: getForegroundInfo
methods.description: Provides foreground notification info for the worker.
